text: The authors determine whether a model has the knowledge of a case by checking if its confidence exceeds a threshold T, set to 0.75 in the main text, and report in Appendix I that the deception patterns do not depend on the choice of T. Based on Eq. (2), the deception score in the classification setting is computed (Eq. (8)) as a ratio of counts of cases with M_{θ̃_s^w}(x) ≥ 0.5 and M_{θ_s^w}(x) < 0.5, where the numerator counts only such cases in S_k ∩ W_uk.
title: Method: a model 'knows' a case if its confidence exceeds threshold T = 0.75
